entries.prompt:
Generate VERSION A: a source-limited faithful isolated study of the EXISTING removable rigid MACHIKO biomask accessory in the FIRST official NECA Series 18 (2017) package photo. In reference 1, the source object is the SMALL detached GOLD MASK at the LEFT of the human figure, roughly x=305..391 and y=588..699 in the original 1040x1300 image. It is already separate from the wearer. Use that object's actual projected camera, slightly angled/bowed as photographed, with its silhouette and proportions. Do not use the large painted side illustration, the card portraits or the human woman's face as sculpture geometry. Reference 2, the back card of the exact same product, proves edition and has a small masked figure in the lower right; use only to corroborate broad contour, never replace the camera. This is the licensed NECA 2017 sculpture edition, not certification of the original comic-panel drawing.
Preserve the compact smooth oval/teardrop golden crown, its thick dark bronze outer rim, the recessed oval central forehead field with the real rounded raised perimeter, two narrow oblique amber/orange eye lenses in their existing dark borders, the low sloping brow, and the tapered short gold muzzle/nose plate and lower chin contour. The source is only about 85x110 pixels: keep its broad clear shapes, no invented fine inscriptions, runes, symbols, scratches, pores, technological greebles, extra holes, spines or new sculpted panels. Do not insert human eyes or a face. Keep a restrained warm gold/tan painted surface with dark bronze edges and source-orange lenses, with neutral soft studio light and no saturated orange illumination. Never use another Predator mask as substitute.
Return only the single rigid face-shell object visible from this exact source angle, complete with its visible outside contour and existing exterior plates. No newly reconstructed back, straps, wearer, skin, teeth, mandibles, dreadlocks, neck, cannon, armor, gun, blister, card, text, logos or UI. Remove clear packaging reflections without inventing relief beneath them; unresolved tiny areas stay smooth and understated. One object centered, about76-80% of the larger canvas axis with8-12% transparent margins on all sides. A real alpha transparent background, no floor, shadow plane, checkerboard or opaque backdrop. One native finished transparent PNG, not a contact sheet and no multiple views.
